URBAN DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 2 OF 1980
Order under Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 2 of the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, No.2 of 1980, I, Maithripala Sirisena, President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka upon the recommendationof the Minister-in-charge of the subject of Urban Development being of the opinion that the lands specified in theSchedule hereto are urgently required for the Kottawa Town Centre Development Project do by this Order declare thatthe said land is required for the aforesaid purpose.
MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA,President.Presidential Secretariat,Colombo 01,October 8th, 2019.
